notes: INA series 26611, variable 'Caudal medio diario' (daily mean flow), station Posadas (INA station 14, Prefectura Naval Argentina code 80) (INA a5 API).

INA's per-reading flow series at this station (series 863, variable 'Caudal') is labeled as computed from a rating curve ('Curva de gasto'), so these daily means rest on the gauge level put through a rating curve. The daily series itself is labeled 'medición directa', which looks like a default label (INA a5 API).
INA publishes no per-value quality flag, so every value is marked measured, including the most recent days, which INA may still correct (INA a5 API).
